concepts.name: Multiplication history and the n log n conjecture
concepts.gloss: Schönhage–Strassen gave O(n log n log log n) and conjectured n log n optimal; Fürer and others improved the factor; Harvey–van der Hoeven reached O(n log n).

evidence.quote: proposed $n\log n$ as the optimal order of growth
Harvey and van der Hoeven reached the unconditional $O(n\log n)$ upper

concepts.name: Multiplication as convolution of radix digits
concepts.gloss: Splitting both integers into short radix digits turns the integer product into a convolution of digit lists, followed by carry propagation.

evidence.quote: Splitting the inputs into radix digits reduces multiplication to
convolution of short integer coefficients

concepts.name: Fourier transforms and butterfly operations
concepts.gloss: A discrete Fourier transform evaluates a sequence at roots of unity, turning cyclic convolution into pointwise products; fast versions use layers of two-point butterflies.

evidence.quote: the transform calculation consists of address
rearrangements, signed shifts, and two-point butterfly operations

concepts.name: Polynomial ring modulo y^r + 1
concepts.gloss: Complex polynomials in y reduced by y^r=-1, with r a power of two; multiplying by a power of y is a signed cyclic shift of the coefficient list.

evidence.quote:
one coordinate
is stored as the coefficient list of a polynomial modulo $y^r+1$, with $r$ a power of two

multiplication by
such a root is a signed shift of the coefficient list

concepts.title: Polynomial ring modulo $y^r + 1$

symbols.name: ring variable
symbols.meaning: The polynomial indeterminate whose powers act as roots of unity.

symbols.name: coefficient count
symbols.meaning: The number of complex coefficients in a record, a power of two.

concepts.name: Synthetic polynomial transforms
concepts.gloss: Nussbaumer-style transforms using powers of y as roots of unity so twiddle multiplications are signed shifts, computed by address rearrangements, shifts and butterflies.

evidence.quote:
These are the
synthetic polynomial transforms of Nussbaumer and Quandalle and
Nussbaumer

concepts.name: Gaussian resampling
concepts.gloss: Harvey–van der Hoeven reduction expressing a Fourier transform of arbitrary axis length through a transform with power-of-two axes, with source and target permutations kept in the identity.

evidence.quote:
Gaussian
resampling then expresses each source Fourier transform through a
power-of-two tensor transform

concepts.name: Chinese-remainder map to prime cyclic axes
concepts.gloss: Placing the digit list on a product of distinct prime cyclic axes by a Chinese-remainder address map that preserves convolution.

evidence.quote:
Chinese-remainder map that preserves
convolution

concepts.name: Bluestein chirp conversion
concepts.gloss: Bluestein's identity rewrites a transform (with its target permutation) as a normalized cyclic convolution via chirp factors.

evidence.quote: Bluestein's chirp identity converts the middle transform

concepts.name: Phase twist to the polynomial ring
concepts.gloss: A twist on the last cyclic coordinate makes its wraparound negative, turning it into a polynomial modulo y^r+1 whose negative wrap restores the cyclic wrap after untwisting.

evidence.quote: A phase twist changes the last cyclic coordinate into a polynomial

concepts.name: Signed packing of polynomial products
concepts.gloss: Kronecker-style packing of signed coefficients into integers so ring products are computed with the established O(n log n) multiplier as an ordinary subroutine.

evidence.quote:
Signed coefficient
packing is a form of Kronecker substitution
Calls to the established $O(n\log n)$ multiplier are ordinary subroutine

concepts.name: Array order, streams and controlled shifts
concepts.gloss: Elementary tape operations: scanning arrays in address order, stream operations and controlled shifts/rational scalings that cost linear time.

evidence.quote: \section{The machine model and elementary streams}
Controlled shifts and fixed rational scalings

concepts.name: Linear networks with roles and frames
concepts.gloss: A fixed linear network exchanging two banks of values with signs and restoring auxiliaries; wires are roles, rows are distributed among W roles, and invertible frames D_v change array representation so intermediate frames cancel.

evidence.quote: Each procedure arises from its own fixed linear network that exchanges two
We call $D_v$ its frame

concepts.name: Finite networks from three-element subsets
concepts.gloss: Construction attaching nested subspaces of an m-dimensional space to gates, using three-element subset intersection counts, gather/scatter and auxiliary wires, so total smaller calls s < W m.

evidence.quote:
The construction uses
three-element subsets

The decisive property is that the total
number $s$ of smaller calls satisfies $s<Wm$.

concepts.name: Recursive power saving
concepts.gloss: A call at parameter mf uses s calls at parameter f on volume V/W streams; since s/W<m, cost per volume grows like a power less than 1 of the parameter instead of linearly.

evidence.quote:
This strict inequality
is the source of the power saving.

concepts.name: Fast interchange of address chunks
concepts.gloss: Interchanges two disjoint contiguous address fields of u bits in a Cartesian-product array in O(V u^τ) with τ<1, via XOR combinations and address shears, yielding an exact permutation.

evidence.quote: The first procedure interchanges two disjoint contiguous address fields
Its cost is $O(Vu^\tau)$ for a fixed $\tau<1$.

concepts.name: Fast simultaneous butterfly layers
concepts.gloss: Applies H0(u,v)=((u+v)/2,(u-v)/2) on the same bit of at most d address chunks of polynomial records of complex fixed-point numbers in O(V d^λ'), λ'<1, using exact Gaussian dyadics and one final truncation.

evidence.quote: The second procedure applies

the cost is $O(Vd^{\lambda'})$ for a
fixed $\lambda'<1$

concepts.name: Precision, error bound and exact recovery
concepts.gloss: Fixed-point precision analysis showing the recovered coefficient error is below 1/2 so rounding, rescaling and carry propagation give the exact integer product.

evidence.quote:
proves that the recovered
coefficient error is strictly below $1/2$

evidence.quote: in $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$ worst-case time, with
disproves the $n\log n$ optimality conjecture
